title: HCF of Coefficients
text:
Find the HCF of 6, 9, and 12:

Factors of 6: 1, 2, 3, 6
Factors of 9: 1, 3, 9
Factors of 12: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12

Common factors: 1, 3
HCF = 3

title: HCF of Variables
text:
Powers of $x$ in each term:
- $6x^3$ has $x^3$
- $-9x^2$ has $x^2$
- $12x$ has $x^1$

Take the lowest power: $x^1 = x$

title: The HCF
text:
HCF = $3 \times x = 3x$

This is the common factor we will take out.
